scene.note: A z-index only counts inside the stacking context around it, so the menu and the seat guides are only as high as the layers that hold them.

steps.note: Kwame clicks Visit, and the menu opens out of the header, over the big picture.
Walking up from the menu, each element's position and z-index decide which one makes a closed layer around it.
On the page, the layer that holds the menu is compared with the picture's layer, and the higher one is painted on top.
When the menu's layer is the higher one, the menu opens on top of the picture on every screen.
A visitor opens the Seat guide on the first card, and its panel reaches down over the next card.
Each card's position and z-index decide whether it is a closed layer of its own.
When the open panel is not shut inside a layer below the later cards, it is painted on top of them.

value.label: what stays
values: the header sticks to the top
the caption sits on the picture
each badge sits on its card

steps.note: The header keeps sticking to the top of the screen while the page scrolls under it.
The caption is placed against the picture, and each badge against its card, so both keep their position.
With every position kept and only the layers changed, the menu and the guides are on top and nothing moves.
